cooldown_comparison.cooldown_only: minimum dwell without pressure threshold or persistence
cooldown_comparison.rads_h: threshold band plus consecutive pressure persistence and switching cost
cooldown_comparison.separation: cooldown is a comparator, not RADS-H

limitations: Formal state semantics do not establish empirical switching stability.
No RADS-H material experiment or service/cost effect estimate is executed by this task.
Objective scores and risk signals retain the RADS-BASELINE-v1 provenance boundary.
The policy proposes a switch and never owns durable business state or Java validation.
A later parameter change requires a new mechanism version and manifest digest.
question: What exact hysteresis state transition will be compared with RADS-BASELINE-v1 and a simple cooldown?

regime.change_behavior: reset pressure and dwell, hold, then collect fresh pressure

state.pressure_definition: consecutive ticks with relative advantage at or above enter_threshold

transition.enter: advantage >= enter_threshold and persistence_ticks reached after minimum dwell
transition.switch_action: emit switch proposal, apply switching_cost, reset pressure and dwell
transition.hold_action: retain active strategy and emit explicit reason
